items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: And Jess Price is witnessing all of this. He's just rolling on the floor, on the couch, everywhere, in the chair.

ctx.x: We were talking about Monty Kaye living next door.

Yeah. So he heard this rumbling next door so he came in, knocked, open the door and came in. I gave him a swish of the thing, talking about, talk about troops withdrawing, he slammed the door and got out of there (laughter). And Jess Price is witnessing all of this. He's just rolling on the floor, on the couch, everywhere, in the chair. He's getting out of our way (laughter).

So that night I left and went to work and I told Mike Osserman that she work for I say, "She won't be to work tonight," but before I left home I run a bathtub full of cold water with a box of table salt in it and put her in it to close up the welts, you know. So I just knew she wasn't going to be at work.
